summary: On-template, the argument reads well and PowerPoint matches the HTML; two slides need content changes before showing.

findings.fix: deck: add the takeaway panel the layout provides

findings.issue: Panel heading breaks as 'repeat-' / 'driven' — a one-word second line
Native chart axis labels sit about 1 px lower in PowerPoint than in HTML
findings.fix: shared: calibrate native chart label placement (engine issue)

findings.issue: Content fills only the top half; the lower half is empty
findings.fix: Add a result line, logos or proof points — or accept the whitespace

findings.fix: Shorten the decision to two lines, e.g. 'Commit €3M on 30 October'
